description: This file defines a namespace and a helper function for performing JMESPath searches within the JmesPath library. It provides an interface to perform data filtering based on expressions, delegating the operation to the Env class.
external_files: Env class within the same namespace

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the provided data using a specified expression. Delegates to the Env class's search method.
